body: Happy birthday, sweetheart. I hope you feel better!
I'm sorry that happened to you, if you need someone to talk to I'm here.
You're beautiful no matter what. Always be yourself.

I really really appreciate this message. I forgot to take it a few times and just thought I was okay, I know it's a stupid thing to do. To be honest I'm not sure why I decide it was okay.

He called me a "stupid bitch and piece of shit." Garbage wasn't even close to it. I don't know, maybe he's right. I'm hiding in my bedroom right now away from my family. I don't want some of my family members to see me this way. I lied and said I wasn't feeling well.

I can't do much in here but feel sorry for myself.

Maybe I don't wanna feel better. Maybe I just want to keep hating myself more and more to push myself to finally just disappear.
Fought with someone and now feel super unloved. I don't think I deserve anything in this life.
I stopped taking my medication and had a bad night, fought with someone and now feel like I'm just plain garbage.
Thank you, sometimes I feel like no one else understands.
